description:
Join us as we discuss the latest and greatest with our September 2026 Prompt Poets Society. This is our 1 year anniversary so there will be cake. We will convene again at Auror's amazing offices near Britomart on the 29th of September at 5.30pm.

title: Learn Public Speaking, Leadership Skills & Confidence with Toastmasters ™️
location: Jubilee Building, 545 Parnell Rd, Parnell, Auckland
description:
Toast of Broadway Toastmasters welcomes anyone who would like to improve their speaking skills to join our meetings. No previous experience is necessary - come and share your experiences with us!

At Toast of Broadway we like to balance having fun, learning and building a community. Every meeting you will have the chance to speak on the stage and try out a variety of speaking roles. Come along to see what we're all about!

For more than 25 years we have offered our members a proven and enjoyable way to practice their communication skills.

"Join Toastmasters. Oral communication skills count! " - Tom Peters, Author

Our Club is part of Toastmasters International's network of over 13,000 clubs that meet in 113 countries around the world.

Toastmasters is a non-profit organisation which provides a forum for people to improve their speaking and leadership skills. Our members come from all walks of life which offers participants a great opportunity for networking.

Meetings are non-political, non-religious, and open to anyone 18 years or older. We have heaps of free car parking at the spaces around the building marked as 'Jubilee".

Many professional bodies recognize the time spent In Toastmasters towards their membership Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Hours requirement E.g. Lawyers, Chartered Accountants. Please check with your relevant bodies for further details.

Follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/toastbroadway

For more information visit out website https://toastofbroadway.org.nz

title: Deep Dive into Jev & System One Models
description:
Looking for a chill but productive space to code, learn, and connect with other developers? Whether you’re just starting out or deep into a side project, you’re welcome here.

🔥 **This Fortnight's Spotlight: Jev & System One Models** Tired of wrestling with LLMs that hallucinate, break your JSON, and take 10 seconds to respond? This week, we're doing a quick 10-minute demo on **Jev** by TypeSafe AI—a brand new "System One" AI model.
Instead of acting like a chatbot that generates strings word-by-word, Jev acts like a lightning-fast function call. You give it unstructured data, and it outputs perfectly typed, probabilistic decisions in under 500 milliseconds. We'll look at why this parallel architecture is a game-changer for AI automation in your apps, and run a live demo of it in action.

🌟 **The Vibe & Details:** Alongside the demo, this remains a casual, community-driven space where you can:

• 💻 Work on your own coding projects
• 🎯 Share goals or progress (totally optional!)
• 🎙️ Talk tech, app development, and AI integration • ☕ Meet like-minded people over coffee

Come with your laptop, your curiosity, or just a love for tech. Stay for the connections and good vibes. No pressure, no strict schedule—just code, coffee, and vibes.

☕ *Note: This event is hosted at a local café, so we kindly ask that you support the venue by purchasing a drink or snack if you can.*

📅 We usually hold meetups every fortnight (bi-weekly)—use them to connect, share, and learn from others.

📚 **Want to geek out before you arrive? Check out these pre-reads:**

* [Introducing System One Models & Jev](http://typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev?utm_source=gemini) *(TypeSafe AI's official technical blog post)*
* [System One Models Explained](https://www.datacamp.com/blog/system-one-models-jev?utm_source=gemini) *(A great 10-minute summary by DataCamp)*

description:
Hi Architects,

Welcome to the next AWS Auckland Well Architected User Group Meetup of 2026!

At each meetup, we focus on learning and networking in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere and explore best-practices in AWS. This has resulted in the AWS Well-Architected Meetups becoming the most popular AWS Meetups in ANZ 🥳

**Please also note that AWS Security now requests a company name and company email where it is available. If you are a student, please list your institution and your student email address at that institution 👍**

We'll be announcing more speakers on https://well-architected.me/events and previewing presentations during the coming weeks - our speakers and details this month include:

* **Dinesh Sharma, AWS Regional Practice Lead, Datacom**

**Zero to Qazo: Building a Product with Kiro, AI & AWS**

Qazo with a simple idea, using Kiro and AI to turn it into a real product, eventually deploying it on AWS. This session is about that journey — what worked, what didn't, the lessons learned from vibe coding and why everyone should try building something of their own to experience the full journey from idea → build → break → learn → deploy.

* **Mystery Speaker**

**Generative Al Cost Optimisation**

Cost Optimisation is essential but with all the anecdotal stories of massive token budget blowouts, staying on top of Generative Al best-practices is essential to avoiding these scenarios.
